validated: Default token ceiling remains 999200; maximum compiled owner-granted ceiling is 3000000.
An expanded allocation requires exact immutable grant and authorization bindings.
Grant application is atomic, preserves historical reserved counters, event documents, ledger versions and original shared USD1 allocation, and rejects changed fresh snapshots.
Same applied grant is idempotent; missing, altered, replacement or rolled-back grants fail closed.
Native per-call limits remain separate from lifetime token limits; attempts100, INR2700 lifetime and INR2540 disconnect controls remain unchanged.
New reservations bind exact ceiling and grant scope; a change during an admitted turn rejects.
Firestore timestamp events/metadata serialize into JSON-safe complete document and event digests without exposing raw events.
A pending journal records exact intended grant before writes; an unsupported post-commit readback preserves this journal rather than reporting success without a receipt.
limitations: No real grant or owner approval was created. Synthetic authorization inside unit tests is not operational authority.
No hosted provider quality, latency, prompt-cache, delivery or deployment acceptance is established by these tests.
